channel.title: THE SIGNAL — Weekly Dispatches
channel.description: Weekly transmissions and field notes from the front lines of 1Commerce LLC — proof-first commerce infrastructure, built in public from Canby, Oregon.

item.title: The Signal Went Quiet
item.description: Forty-six commits. Twelve merged pull requests. Two hundred forty-nine files touched. The weekly dispatch went dark for four weeks, June 1 through June 28 — the build log never did.

item.title: Built For The Machines
item.description: Six GEO/SEO commits in seven days. Five PRs merged. Forty-four daily briefs patched with schema. The crawlers that decide what gets cited don't care about glamour — they care about structured, current, correctly-tagged truth.

item.title: Cathedral Principle in Action
item.description: Eleven active work streams. Zero placeholders. Eight verified deployments. One v1.0 game release. One music video pipeline. One licensing cascade. Fifteen thousand memoir words in hand.
